# /oss:ship round 3 gate context (tool-gates, R-253)

**Read-only gate. Do not edit, stage, commit or push anything. Do not run `git -C`. Leave no processes running (check `pgrep -fl tool-gate.cjs; pgrep -fl vitest` before you finish).**

- Repo: `/Users/ysl/dev/oss-plugin-tool-gates`, branch `feat/tool-gates/build`. Changes under review: the commits since the merge base with `origin/feat/determinism-sprint/build` (`git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/feat/determinism-sprint/build)`) PLUS the uncommitted working tree (`git diff HEAD`, and untracked files from `git status`). The feature: a Node CLI `tool-gate` (`watcher/src/cli/tool-gate.ts`, `watcher/src/tool-gate/**`, bundled to `watcher/dist/cli/tool-gate.cjs`, run by `hooks/oss-tool-gate.sh` from `hooks/hooks.json`, rules in `config/tool-gates.json`). It refuses IRON LAW violations in Claude Code PreToolUse (Bash/Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) with exit 2 and records test runs for a per-cycle RED rule. Allow = exit 0 with no stdout; refuse = exit 2, reason on stderr; a crash or timeout allows by design (ADR-005).
- This is round 3 (report only). Rounds 1-2 fixed many findings. The round-2 fix diff is at `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ysl-dev-oss-plugin-tool-gates/2dd4ade3-c8f4-4ee8-a00a-c9b7978a8f6b/scratchpad/round2.diff` — focus there first, then the whole change.
- Design docs: `.oss/dev/active/tool-gates/DESIGN.md` (Known Limits), `DECISIONS.md` (ADR-001..010), `NOTES.md` (entries F1..R2c). These are claims, not evidence: a documented "known limit" is still a finding if it is a real bypass; say if it is already listed there.
- Already-deferred items are in `.oss/dev/FOLLOWUPS.md` lines ending "from: tool-gates (round 1)" / "(round 2)". You may re-report them, but mark them "already in FOLLOWUPS".
- User decisions that are intended behaviour (report a finding only if the implementation is wrong or opens a real bypass): refuse only real writes to protected files ("loosen to real writes"); reads of `.oss/workflow-state.json` allowed, writes refused; mkdir of folders allowed; `git clean` refused only when git says an untracked protected file would be deleted; `git checkout -b X && git push -u origin X` allowed for a new non-protected X; GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_*/GIT_TRACE* allowed on commit/push; `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` read as the project root; unreadable shell parts refused only when risky (ADR-010).
- Tests: `cd watcher && npx vitest run` (full) or `npx vitest run test/tool-gate test/cli test/hooks` (scoped). Exactly 3 failures are known and fixed elsewhere (PR #221, not yet merged into this branch): model-frontmatter, offload-step-safety, chain-step-contract — do not count them. Type check: `cd watcher && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p .` (never npx tsc). Do NOT run `npm run build` (it writes untracked dist files); the bundle check is `test/hooks/tool-gate-dist.test.ts`.
- To exercise the real gate: build hook JSON (`{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"..."},"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","cwd":"<dir>"}`) and pipe it to `node watcher/dist/cli/tool-gate.cjs pre` (check `watcher/src/cli/tool-gate.ts` / `hooks/oss-tool-gate.sh` for the exact argv and env, e.g. `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`). Do it in a fresh `mktemp -d` git repo, never against this checkout's real state. The gate only decides; it never runs the command — never run the attack commands themselves.

Report format: PASS/FAIL, then each finding with severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), "security" if it is one, file:line, a one-sentence failure (input → wrong result), whether you reproduced it through the real gate, and whether it is new in round 2's fixes or older.
